mapper.delete: DELETE FROM code_chunks WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND file_path IN #{path}
mapper.select: SELECT commit_sha FROM code_chunks WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

sql.if: AND(POSITION(LOWER(#{query}) IN LOWER(file_path))>0 OR POSITION(LOWER(#{query}) IN LOWER(asset_type))>0 OR POSITION(LOWER(#{query}) IN LOWER(COALESCE(symbol_name,'')))>0 OR POSITION(LOWER(#{query}) IN LOWER(COALESCE(symbol_kind,'')))>0 OR POSITION(LOWER(#{query}) IN LOWER(COALESCE(language,'')))>0 OR POSITION(LOWER(#{query}) IN LOWER(content))>0)

mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (symbol_name,file_path) symbol_name,symbol_kind,file_path,start_line,end_line,language FROM code_chunks WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} AND asset_type='CODE' AND symbol_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM(symbol_name)<>''
AND POSITION('/' IN file_path)=0
AND file_path LIKE CONCAT(#{modulePrefix},'/%') AND file_path LIKE CONCAT('%/',#{layerSegment},'/%')
AND (file_path=#{modulePrefix} OR file_path LIKE CONCAT(#{modulePrefix},'/%'))
ORDER BY symbol_name,file_path,start_line LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM code_chunks WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId}
